examples.arabic: ركض اللاعب الشهير بسرعة نحو المرمى
examples.english: The famous player ran quickly toward the goal.
examples.transliteration: rakada allaib ashshahir bisura nahwa almarma

examples.arabic: ركض لاعب صغير بسرعة كبيرة نحو المرمى
examples.english: A small player ran very fast towards the goal.
examples.transliteration: Rakada laa'ibun sagheerun bi-sur'atin kabeeratin nahwa l-marma.

examples.arabic: لاعب واحد كان بطيئا جدا والكرة كانت سريعة جدا
examples.english: One player was very slow and the ball was very fast
examples.transliteration: Laa'ibun waahidun kaana bateei'an jiddan wal-kuratu kaanat saree'atan jiddan
